comments.1: Listen for what about the old man troubles the speaker.
comments.2: The narrator waited because the old man’s eye stayed closed each night. Now the old man has heard a sound. What will the narrator do?
comments.3: The police have come after a neighbor heard a scream, while the body is hidden beneath the floor. How will the narrator behave with them?
